dark.shortEffect: Gradually boosts SPEED.

dark.name: stakeout
dark.shortEffect: Doubles the damage dealt to the target’s replacement if the target switches out.

dark.name: stall
dark.shortEffect: The Pokémon moves after even slower foes.

dark.name: stench
dark.shortEffect: Helps repel wild POKéMON.

dark.name: suction-cups
dark.shortEffect: Firmly anchors the body.

dark.name: super-luck
dark.shortEffect: Heightens the critical-hit ratios of moves.

dark.name: supreme-overlord
dark.shortEffect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

dark.name: swarm
dark.shortEffect: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.

dark.name: swift-swim
dark.shortEffect: Raises SPEED in rain.

dark.name: sword-of-ruin
dark.shortEffect: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

dark.name: synchronize
dark.shortEffect: Passes on status problems.

dark.name: tablets-of-ruin
dark.shortEffect: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

dark.name: tinted-lens
dark.shortEffect: Powers up “not very effective” moves.

dark.name: torrent
dark.shortEffect: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.

dark.name: unburden
dark.shortEffect: Raises Speed if a held item is used.

dark.name: unnerve
dark.shortEffect: Makes the foe nervous and unable to eat Berries.

dark.name: unseen-fist
dark.shortEffect: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

dark.name: vessel-of-ruin
dark.shortEffect: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

dark.name: water-absorb
dark.shortEffect: Changes water into HP.

dark.name: weak-armor
dark.shortEffect: Physical attacks lower Defense and raise Speed.

dark.name: wind-rider
dark.shortEffect: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
